<module id="freq_divbyodd">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by odd numbers. The module generates a divided clock output by an odd divisor value provided as a parameter.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal that initializes the divider.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="NUM_DIV">Odd divisor value for frequency division.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt1" width_description="[3:0]">Counter for tracking rising edge clock cycles.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt2" width_description="[3:0]">Counter for tracking falling edge clock cycles.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div1" width_description="[1:0]">Clock divider for rising edge.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div2" width_description="[1:0]">Clock divider for falling edge.</reg>
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (~rst_n) begin
                cnt1 <= 'd0;
                cnt2 <= 'd0;
                clk_div1[0] <= 1'd0;
                clk_div1[1] <= 1'd0;
                clk_div2[0] <= 1'd0;
                clk_div2[1] <= 1'd0;
            end else begin
                if(cnt1 == ((NUM_DIV/2)-1))begin
                    cnt1 <= 'd0;
                    clk_div1[0] <= ~clk_div1[0];
                end else begin
                    cnt1 <= cnt1 + 1;
                end
                
                if(cnt2 == ((NUM_DIV/2)-1))begin
                    cnt2 <= 'd0;
                    clk_div2[0] <= ~clk_div2[0];
                end else begin
                    cnt2 <= cnt2 + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)> //rising edge clk_div1
            if(~rst_n)begin
                clk_div1[1] <= 1'd0;
            end else begin
                if(clk_div1[0])begin
                    clk_div1[1] <= ~clk_div1[1];
                end
            end
        end
        
        <always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n))//falling edge clk_div2
            if(~rst_n)begin
                clk_div2[1] <= 1'd0;
            end else begin
                if(clk_div2[0])begin
                    clk_div2[1] <= ~clk_div2[1];
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Uses two clock dividers to generate divided clock output based on odd divisor values.</implementation>
</module>
